payload.core_mechanism_summary: Left-to-right greedy parse: when seeing a 1, consume the longest valid token (1, 14, or 144) by checking next digits; if any step fails or forbidden digit appears, reject.
payload.rationale: The solution makes iterative greedy choices to parse the string without backtracking. Correctness relies on a greedy principle provable by exchange: if the number is magic, greedy parsing never fails.
